name: Victor Negrescu - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 - Adjustment in payment appropriations, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text:
The European Parliament approves changes to the European Union's 2025 budget. These changes add about 2.52 billion euros in payments and 123.7 million euros in commitments. They also update the revenue side, including 1.19 billion euros in fines and penalties and 1.3 billion euros in customs duties. Because of this extra money, member states only need to pay 31.9 million euros more. The Parliament also calls for faster spending on regional funds, farming support and new technology.

- Payments rise by 2.52 billion euros, including 2 billion more for regional development projects.
- Member states pay only 31.9 million euros more, thanks to extra fines and customs revenue.
- Parliament approves the plan; the budget change is then formally adopted and published.
